column1: # Golden values for the native wcslib projections.
# Captured from the vendored wcslib C (AST's fork, reference/starlink-ast at 3d3f255f, as vendored in commit 31b6f78e) built -O3 -ffp-contract=off on macOS aarch64.
# Every double is its IEEE 754 bit pattern in 16 hex digits; "nan" stands for any NaN.
# FI phi theta        shared forward inputs, degrees.
# RI x y              shared reverse inputs.
# S CODE STRIDE TPNTAN PV   a parameter set: projection code, the stride at which the shared inputs are used (every STRIDE-th),
#                     whether TPN includes the TAN projection, and the parameters as axis:m:value,... (axis 2 latitude, axis 1 longitude; "-" for none).
# A h*14              the parameters p[0..=6] of the latitude axis then of the longitude axis, defaults included.
# E fwd rev           the set-up fails: the status of a first forward call and of a first reverse call, each on a fresh struct; nothing else follows.
# F st [x y]          for each used FI in order: the status and, when 0, the projected x y.
# R st [phi theta]    for each used RI in order: the status and, when 0, the native phi theta.
# X x y st [phi theta]  reverse points particular to the set (projection facet edges and forward outputs), with their inputs.
